''See also: [[Nakothi Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nakothi, also known as the [[Dead Mother]], is a [[Great Elder]] who seeks to achieve a perfect equilibrium between life and death. An alien and incomprehensible entity, she once ruled the [[Heartland|Heartlands]], which served as the birthplace of humanity. Her presence is characterized by a combination of rotting death and vibrant life, often accompanied by an insatiable [[hunger]] and a putrid scent. Though her cults were largely eradicated by the [[Luminian|Luminians]] centuries ago, her influence remains through her ability to warp human bodies into monstrous forms and her tendency to claim corpses as vessels. Her physical form is massive; after being defeated by the Emperor and the [[Estyr Six]], her death throes shattered the surrounding land, creating an island where her corpse fell. Even in a state of defeat, her body remains a source of immense power and destruction, capable of breaking mountains and reaching toward the sky with hands large enough to block out the sun. Nakothi possesses multiple hearts, which are powerful objects that can be used to influence others or grant life. She also commands various entities, including her [[Handmaiden]] and the [[Children of Nakothi]]—monstrous beings often constructed from human remains or repurposed biological parts. While some view her as actively evil, she is primarily driven by a desire to escape or find new purposes for the living and the dead alike.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nakothi possesses a vast, not-quite-dead body that is associated with hideous dead creatures and monstrosities. Her presence is characterized by a twisted blend of rotting death and vibrant life, accompanied by an insatiable [[hunger]] and a putrid stench. She is also known as the [[Dead Mother]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Described as mad, Nakothi pursues a perfect balance of life and death while desiring the malicious destruction of humankind. She believes she improves humans by warping their bodies into her [[Children]] and is known to toy with death. Her influence can be felt as a song in the mind or a stench in certain cells.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nakothi is connected to the Emperor, whom she can harm, corrupt, or take over. She interacts with [[Shera]] through mental laughter and physical confrontation, while [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] theorizes that [[Shera]] may be one of the few capable of threatening her. Additionally, Nakothi is an unknown entity alongside [[Kthanikahr]], [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion|Tharlos]], and [[Othaghor]], and her presence is noted in relation to [[Kelarac]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Nakothi]]'s power is a fading [[Shadow|shadow]] of its former self.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Known as the [[Dead Mother]], Nakothi is an unknown entity whose death throes are currently destroying the land.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> While the [[Am’haranai]] once accepted contracts from her, she eventually took control of the Emperor's mind, though he may have previously been secretly moved by her influence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref> [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] theorized that [[Shera]] might be the only person besides the [[Regents]] capable of threatening Nakothi.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> As a being whose song can be heard within the mind, Nakothi is capable of taking a host to rise against the [[Outsider]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> Ultimately, [[Shera]] tore Nakothi's power from the stirring bodies and the entity was defeated.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] is known as the [[Dead Mother]] and her death throes are destroying the land.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Am’haranai]] once took contracts from [[Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor may have been secretly moved by [[Nakothi]]’s influence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] took over the Emperor's mind.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] theorized [[Shera]] might be the only one besides [[Regents]] who could threaten [[Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] is an unknown entity.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] tore [[Nakothi]]’s power from the stirring bodies.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] is a being that can take a host and rise to battle the [[Outsider]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] is a being whose song can be heard in the mind.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]] was defeated.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
